retrievalProfile.description: A moody, monochromatic group portrait featuring high-contrast lighting, 80s rock fashion, and a combination of heavy stamped block lettering and delicate cursive script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A group of five men with voluminous 80s hairstyles and dark clothing, posed in a tight cluster against a textured, sepia-toned background, framed by a prominent diagonal stamped logo in the upper left and thin script in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal stamped logo balances the group composition
High-contrast lighting emphasizes facial features and hair texture
Monochromatic sepia tint unifies the subjects and background
Juxtaposition of heavy block type and thin cursive script
coreInvariants: Diagonal orientation of the primary display text
Textured, distressed border around the primary text block
Sepia or magenta-tinted monochromatic color grade

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five subjects arranged in a pyramid-like cluster, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red-tinted diagonal block text in the top left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold logo in the top left, down through the central faces, to the script in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the upper corners around the text elements.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-value highlights on skin and hair
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Desaturated red for the primary logo block
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, stamped texture within the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are enclosed in a double-lined rectangular frame
The entire text block is rotated approximately 15 degrees
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between heavy industrial block type and delicate personal handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy condensed skeleton of the primary logo.
Approximates the casual, thin-stroke cursive of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, sepia-toned group portrait of five men in 80s rock attire (leather, denim) with voluminous hair, posed against a textured wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, red-tinted, distressed block-letter logo in a double-lined frame at a 15-degree angle in the top left, and a thin white cursive script in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text tilted diagonally?
Is the color palette monochromatic sepia/magenta?
Is there a clear contrast between the block text and the script?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distress on the logo

mustAchieve: Tactile, stamped quality to the typography

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast lighting on faces
Ensure the logo has a distressed, stamped texture
Verify the monochromatic color grade is consistent
Confirm the diagonal placement of the primary text
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Rock Portrait + Sepia Tint + Diagonal Stamped Logo + Cursive Subtitle
